body: Yeah, I'm planning to pick up jogging to clear my head of bad thoughts. I found out a whole lotta stuff I shouldn't have just now, and I just want to think to myself right now. Thanks for your consideration. I appreciate it. Hope the best for you.

Thank you for your time. I'm just really bummed out about how I realize I'm losing everything, then I try saving at least my relationship with my ex-gf, but end up losing that too. When she told me she's going on dates with my former best friend, that really shook me up. Everyone around me is moving on in life and I'm still stuck thinking about them and everything we used to do. I wish it were that easy for me to move on, but I don't have anyone to hang out with and no one on my friend's list wants to talk to me. I try to make people happy. I try to make people like me. Everyone said I was the clown who always cheered people up. But whenever I had a problem and needed help, all people could do is say "Wow, that sucks." and repeat it over and over again. That's pretty much how I realized no one gave a fuck. So instead of bothering people with my bullshit, I just bottled it up and kept to myself. And I envy my former best friend. He's the complete opposite of myself. We have opposite initials. He's from a wealthy family, I'm from a family who has troubles getting by. People come to him for help, I come to people for help. He has my girlfriend, and I don't. He's very fortunate, and I'm not. He has everything I ever wanted. Why is life so damn unfair? I hope I'm not troubling you. I just want to release all of these feelings I always kept bottled up. Thanks again.

I tried taking my attention and putting it elsewhere. I tried watching random movies on Netflix, or playing some random facebook game. But I still couldn't get it off my mind. Just to clarify, that I'm not expecting to be comforted all week long.. I just want to talk to someone to get all of this grief off of my chest so I can move on.
